intro.TrustedMarkup: The functions of Int64, its home: Int64.parse(s) calls them with no import. s as a decimal Int64: an optional -, then digits, all consumed; anything else is None. acc * 10 + d wraps, so "9223372036854775808" is Int64.min (examples/numbytes.vyrn). It reads no +.
